title: Japan sought a UAP information-sharing agreement with the US

tellings.quote: Japan just begged the United States to enter into a bilateral information sharing agreement with the United States solely for the purposes of sharing UAP information

plain: Japan "just begged the United States" for a two-country agreement whose only purpose was to share information on UAP, the government's term for unidentified objects in the sky, according to a former Pentagon intelligence official named Luis Elizondo. He says it in a documentary about him made by Michels. Elizondo offers it as a sign that close US allies take these sightings seriously, and he does not say whether the United States agreed.
